Material Classification

By-Product Categories We Host

Facilitating the recovery and reuse of circular industrial secondary inputs.

Chemicals & Solvents

Spent Sulphuric Acid, Spent Acetone, Catalyst Sludge, ETP Sludge, Red Mud

Process acids, organic recovery streams, and inorganic precipitates suitable for neutralization, chemical regeneration, or metallurgy extraction.

Metals & Mining

Blast Furnace Slag, Mill Scale, Aluminium Dross, Copper Slag

Smelter byproducts, oxides, and slag aggregates rich in metallic elements ready for extraction, casting fillers, or abrasive blasting grits.

Minerals & Construction

Fly Ash, Phosphogypsum, Silica Fume

Siliceous residues and chemical mineral derivatives acting as high-performance pozzolanic binder components. Boosts strength characteristics in green concrete composites.

Biomass & Organic

Bagasse, Rice Husk Ash, Oil Sludge

Agrarian agricultural leftovers, bagasse fibers, and carbon residues yielding high calorific fuel feeds or bio-composite fillers.

Paper & Cellulose

Lime Sludge, Black Liquor Residue, Cellulose Fiber Fines

Cellulose fibers and alkaline chemical mineral recovery streams from pulp mills. Reusable for neutralizing soils, cement aggregate blending, or paper re-manufacturing.

Glass & Ceramics

Cullet Residue, Ceramic Slurry, Refractory Slag

Frit and crushed glass scrap, clay slurry precipitates, and spent heat-resistant refractory blocks. Reusable in abrasive mixes, kiln products, or glaze feeds.

Rubbers & Plastics

Polymer Fines, Rubber Crumb, Wax Distillates

Recovered elastomers, vulcanized crumb aggregates, and thermoplastic powders. Suitable as composite fillers, safety flooring, asphalt modifiers, or energy conversion oils.

💡 How TRASURE Calculates Landed Cost

Our real-time routing engine calculates the total delivered cost per metric tonne for every listing, allowing procurement teams to compare the true commercial impact of domestic sourcing alternatives.

Landed Cost/Tonne = Base Price + (Freight Rate × Straight-Line Distance)

Distance is dynamically computed between your delivery site and the seller's origin hub using the Haversine formula (earth's curvature routing).

Core By-Product Classes Available

🧪 Chemicals & Solvents

Active materials: Spent Sulphuric Acid, Spent Acetone, Catalyst Sludge, ETP Sludge, Red Mud

Recovered streams derived from pharmaceutical, dye manufacturing, and metal pickling plants. Suitable for direct industrial neutralization, pH buffers, metal precipitation, and feedstock inputs.

🏗️ Metals & Mining

Active materials: Blast Furnace Slag, Mill Scale, Aluminium Dross, Copper Slag

Metallurgical oxides, process slag, and melting residues. Reclaimable as high-density structural fillers, sub-grade building bases, abrasive sandblast grits, or metallic recovery inputs.

🧱 Minerals & Construction

Active materials: Fly Ash, Phosphogypsum, Silica Fume

Siliceous residues and chemical mineral derivatives acting as high-performance pozzolanic binder components. Boosts strength characteristics in green concrete composites.

🌾 Biomass & Organic

Active materials: Bagasse, Rice Husk Ash, Oil Sludge

Carbon-rich processing co-products and fibrous cane outputs. Utilizable for clean boiler fuel feeds, thermal plant additives, bio-plastics, or organic absorption layers.

📄 Paper & Cellulose

Active materials: Lime Sludge, Black Liquor Residue, Cellulose Fiber Fines

Cellulose fibers and alkaline chemical mineral recovery streams from pulp mills. Reusable for neutralizing acidic soils, cement aggregate blending, or paper re-manufacturing.

🏺 Glass & Ceramics

Active materials: Cullet Residue, Ceramic Slurry, Refractory Slag

Frit and crushed glass scrap, clay slurry precipitates, and spent heat-resistant refractory blocks. Reusable in abrasive mixes, kiln products, or glaze feeds.

🩹 Rubbers & Plastics

Active materials: Polymer Fines, Rubber Crumb, Wax Distillates

Recovered elastomers, vulcanized crumb aggregates, and thermoplastic powders. Suitable as composite fillers, safety flooring, asphalt modifiers, or energy conversion oils.

Sourcing Savings

01/ Zero-Waste Asset Class Desk

Industrial waste streams (spent acids, ash, slag, refinery catalysts) are not liabilities. We standardize their catalog attributes, making by-products clear, tradeable corporate raw materials.

02/ Automated Compliance Gates

Compliance is the foundation of recovery. TRASURE enforces format-compliant State Pollution Control Board (SPCB) validations during onboarding and checkout, blocking unregulated logistics to protect corporate governance.

03/ Real Road Dispatch Verification

We calculate accurate logistics routing over real Indian driving highways via the OSRM engine and auto-generate CPCB Form 10 hazardous waste manifests to match actual physical dispatches.

04/ Landed-Cost Blending Economics

We provide dynamic blending logic to standardise purity requirements. Buyers can combine low-grade outputs with high-purity streams in real-time, reducing cost while satisfying chemical process boundaries.
